label: a wire leaves its output dot level and arrives level into its input dot
eval: (() => { const p = __map.map.plates.get('Pages/Sign in'); const out = []; for (const e of p.curves) { const a = e.curve.getPoint(0), a2 = e.curve.getPoint(0.01), b2 = e.curve.getPoint(0.99), b = e.curve.getPoint(1); const from = p.info.get(e.wire.fromId).outAt.get(e.wire.fromProperty), to = p.info.get(e.wire.toId).inAt.get(e.wire.toProperty); const lv = (u, v) => Math.abs(v.y - u.y) / Math.max(1e-6, Math.hypot(v.x - u.x, v.z - u.z)); out.push(a.distanceTo(from) < 1e-6 && b.distanceTo(to) < 1e-6 && lv(a, a2) < 0.1 && lv(b2, b) < 0.1); } return JSON.stringify({ wires: out.length, allOnTheirDotsAndLevel: out.every(Boolean) }); })()
